ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white and light-grey pixels cover approximately 60% of the visible surface, contrasted against low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels covering 40%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous white patch located on the left lobe outer margin; extensive high-intensity white mottling across the right lobe; low-intensity dark pigmentation concentrated around the median notch and central fluke body.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with multiple sharp peaks and valleys across both lobes; amplitude of variations is more pronounced on the left trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sweeping convex curve on the lateral margins, terminating in sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of high-intensity circular pixel nodes (barnacles) localized on the distal tip and outer margin of the right lobe; scattered high-contrast white spots on the left lobe central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally across the high-intensity white regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the right distal tip; irregular notches along the trailing edge topography suggest previous physical trauma.
